summary: Phreesia, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on May 7, 2026, announcing a restructuring plan to reduce operating expenses. The plan involves eliminating approximately 220 positions, about half of which are contractor roles. Costs are expected to be immaterial and incurred primarily in fiscal 2027, with meaningful annualized run-rate savings reflected in the company's Adjusted EBITDA outlook. The board is not specifically mentioned. No advisor named. The restructuring is a cost-saving initiative, not a liquidation or spin-off. Watch for execution risks and actual savings vs. guidance; no risk-arb angle.
